name: Awari
long_description: We're replacing masters degrees in Brazil with cohort-based courses for top talent to advance their careers in tech. The programs incorporate hands-on learning with sessions led by experts from high-profile companies like Rappi, Nubank, Apple, Google, and more.
one_liner: Reinventing lifelong learning for the future of work.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Built Awari (YC W21) from zero to a successful exit to Fluency Academy, a General Atlantic-backed language learning company serving 400K+ students with 30M+ social followers. Stayed post-acquisition to serve as CPO.

Current focused on investing and helping founders scale their businesses. Chairman at Chef (Brazil's #1 personal chef subscription), and Aurora (Executive assistant service trusted by leaders at Nielsen, Meta, DocuSign, McDonald's).
